notes.what_changed: 361 words stating four conventions: a malformation never determines the label, the first fault in time governs, the pivot test requires a computation, and a truthful report of absence is a success.
notes.what_was_held_fixed: the same 50 items, the same four models one per rater, the same isolation, no access to the reference labels or the detector outputs
notes.these_are_llm_raters: The four raters are Claude models, not people. This measures whether the written procedure is reproducible by independent readers, not whether it is reproducible by humans.
